# P3 — Android App (Jetpack Compose · Material 3 Expressive · Kotlin)

The native Android client at full web parity, using **Jetpack Compose**, **Material 3
(Expressive)**, and Kotlin. Consumes the **KMP shared core** (`apps/shared`) directly as a
Gradle module (ADR-004) — networking, models, SSE, units, auth, cache, presentation are all
shared; this program builds only the Android UI + platform integration.

> Prereqs: P1/S99 DONE. Branch `feat/apps-android` (ADR-007). Read ADR-002/004/005/008/009/011/015.
> Page prompts (A7) are GENERATED by P1/S0-0002 into `p3-android/pages/`.

## Phases

| Phase | Theme | Prompts | Output |
|---|---|---|---|
| **A0** | Project setup | `A0-0001..` | Gradle project, `:app` depends on `:shared`, Compose BOM, Material 3, CI green |
| **A1** | Theme/design | `A1-0001..` | `Theme.kt` from `apps/design` (M3 ColorScheme, dynamic color opt-in, type ramp, dark) |
| **A2** | Component library | `A2-0001..` | Compose equivalents of web shared components (GlassPanel→Surface/tonal, StatCard, chart wrappers via Vico, Maps Compose, EmptyState, Shimmer, lists) |
| **A3** | App scaffold + nav | `A3-0001..` | `Scaffold` + NavigationBar/Rail, Navigation-Compose graph, deep links, predictive back |
| **A4** | Auth + onboarding | `A4-0001..` | OIDC PKCE (AppAuth + Custom Tabs), EncryptedSharedPrefs/Keystore, onboarding |
| **A5** | Live data + FCM | `A5-0001..` | SSE binding (foreground), FCM registration + notification handling (ADR-009) |
| **A6** | (reserved) widgets/wear | `A6-0001..` | Glance home-screen widgets; Wear companion (parity for web `watch` feature) |
| **A7** | **Pages (generated)** | `pages/**` | every web page at parity, Material-3-native |
| **A8** | Platform polish | `A8-0001..` | shortcuts, share targets, edge-to-edge, motion, haptics, settings, per-app language |
| **A9** | Tests | `A9-0001..` | JUnit + Compose UI tests (each parity unit's states) + screenshot tests |
| **A99** | Android acceptance gate | `A99-0001` | parity ledger 100% (android), gates green, signed AAB |

## Binding rules for P3

1. Allowed files scoped to `apps/android/**` (+ `apps/design/generated/android/**` for A1).
2. **Material-3-native only**: M3 components + design tokens; honor dynamic color where the
   user enables it, but keep brand chart palette. No web pixel-cloning, no placeholder screens.
3. UI is **stateless Composables** driven by the **KMP shared-core state holders** (P1/S8) via
   `collectAsStateWithLifecycle`. No networking/business logic in the Android module.
4. A7 page prompts are GENERATED; each must satisfy its embedded `=== PARITY ===` gate + placeholder gate.

## Exit criteria

- `./gradlew :app:assembleDebug lintDebug detekt :app:testDebugUnitTest` green; Compose UI tests pass.
- `apps/parity/android-ledger.json`: every page-unit done, covered==required.
- Signed AAB builds; `A99` log `STATUS=DONE`.
